data.title: Dan Tapiero Says Bitcoin Has Bottomed After U.S.-Japan FX Intervention
data.description: Macro investor Dan Tapiero said Bitcoin has bottomed and will not revisit its lows. According to NS3.AI, Tapiero attributed the move to coordinated U.S.-Japan intervention in the dollar-yen exchange rate, rather than the Treasury's bond buyback program. He said Bitcoin has shifted from a $60,000 to $70,000 range into a $70,000 to $80,000 range.

data.title: Hyperliquid Faces Regulatory Risk Despite $223 Billion in 30-Day Volume, Ran Neuner Says
data.description:
Crypto Banter founder Ran Neuner said regulation is Hyperliquid's biggest risk, even as the perpetual DEX leads the sector with about $223 billion in trading volume over the past 30 days. According to NS3.AI, Neuner said regulators are likely to turn their attention to decentralized platforms after setting rules for centralized exchanges.

He added that Hyperliquid's network effects make it difficult for competitors to challenge its position. U.S. President Donald Trump said CFTC Chair Michael Selig was working to bring Hyperliquid into the US in a fully compliant and legal fashion.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Saudi East-West Oil Pipeline Shut After Attacks
data.description:
Saudi Arabia shut its East-West oil pipeline as a precaution after multiple attacks on Thursday, the Ministry of Energy said, according to Bloomberg.

The line is a key workaround for shipments that cannot transit the Strait of Hormuz.

data.title: Saudi East-West Oil Pipeline Closed Preventively After Multiple Attacks
data.description: Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry said the East-West oil pipeline in the Riyadh and Medina regions was closed preventively after multiple attacks on Thursday. According to Sina Finance, the ministry said emergency and specialist teams responded immediately, took measures to secure the pipeline, and assessed its safety condition. The attacks injured several people, and the ministry said further developments would be announced in due course.

data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said the measures taken to respond to the blockade are acts of self-defense within the framework of international law.

data.title: Goldman Sachs: Renewed Fed Hike Expectations Could Trigger Sharper Gold Correction
data.description: According to Jin10, Goldman Sachs said a renewed rise in expectations for Fed rate hikes could prompt traders to unwind hedging positions, leading to a more volatile-than-usual adjustment in gold prices.

data.title: AI | Oracle Results Ease Concerns Over Its AI Infrastructure Buildout
data.description:
Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow breaks down Oracle's latest results and says they are helping ease concerns about the company's massive AI infrastructure buildout, according to Bloomberg.

He also discusses the growing debate over AI's societal risks and the backlash against the global data center build-out.

data.title: GXO Logistics Sees New-Business Wins, Wincanton Synergies Driving Margin Growth
data.description: According to CNBC, GXO Logistics is seeing accelerating new-business wins that the company and analysts expect to support future revenue growth and margin expansion, while its shares have lagged peers and trade at about 8x forward enterprise value-to-Ebitda. The company said new business wins rose 34% year over year to $410 million in the second quarter, and Wincanton integration is expected to deliver $60 million in cost savings by the end of the year. GXO plans to hold an investor day on Nov. 16, where management is expected to provide more detail on growth, margins and capital deployment. The company also said it will continue buying back shares in the back half of the year.

data.title: Japanese Power Companies, Trading Houses Form Electricity Trading Association
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, Japanese power companies and trading houses were among more than 20 businesses that formed an association on electricity trading Friday to offer the government recommendations on long-term trading.

data.title: JPMorgan Adjusts Fed Forecast, Now Sees Rate Hikes in September and December
data.description: According to Jin10, JPMorgan adjusted its Federal Reserve forecast and now expects rate hikes in September and December.

data.title: Johnson & Johnson Bets On Ottava To Challenge Intuitive Surgical In Robotic Surgery
data.description:
According to CNBC, Johnson & Johnson is pushing into the robotic surgery market with Ottava, which received Food and Drug Administration approval this summer for use in multiple general surgery procedures. The company said the system’s smaller footprint and design features could help it win over surgeons and hospitals, while its surgery business generated $5.16 billion in revenue in the first six months of the year, up 4.3% from a year earlier.

Hani Abouhalka, head of J&J’s surgery and robotics unit, said the company aims to become a leader in surgical robotics. Precedence Research projects the U.S. surgical robotics market will grow from about $4.4 billion in 2025 to $18.75 billion by 2035, while the global market is expected to rise from $14.45 billion in 2026 to about $50.29 billion by 2035. Ottava is approved for 10 general surgery procedures, and J&J said it is pursuing additional approvals in Western Europe and Japan as part of its rollout.

data.title: AI | Cohere Seeks Up to $3 Billion in New Funding
data.description:
Artificial intelligence startup Cohere Inc. is in advanced talks to raise between $2 billion and $3 billion, including financing from the Canadian government and existing backers, according to Bloomberg reported.

The Globe & Mail reported the fundraising discussions.

data.title: Stellantis Signs Memo on Possible Sale of Idle Toronto-Area Plant
data.description:
Stellantis NV has signed a memorandum with Canadian armored vehicle maker Roshel that outlines steps toward a possible sale of an idled car factory near Toronto, according to Bloomberg.

The move is another ripple effect of US tariffs on the Canadian auto sector.

data.title: STOCKS | Hyperliquid Strategies Shares Rise 6.31% Ahead of Senate Clarity Act Vote
data.description:
Hyperliquid Strategies shares rose 6.31% to $11.71 on Friday ahead of an upcoming Senate procedural vote on the Clarity Act. According to NS3.AI, crypto-linked stocks also advanced before the vote.

Cantor Fitzgerald maintained an Overweight rating on the stock and raised its price forecast to $34.20.

data.title: Bolsonaro Urges Public Probe Into Bank Ties
data.description:
Brazil presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro said he has "nothing to hide" as police investigate his ties to a jailed banker, according to Bloomberg.

He urged the country’s top court to make the case fully public ahead of October’s election.

data.title: U.S. August Budget Deficit Narrows to $167 Billion
data.description: According to Jin10, the U.S. government budget deficit was $167 billion in August, compared with a forecast of $404 billion and a previous reading of $432 billion.
